Annada Spices Industry.note: The company operates as a sole proprietorship founded and owned by Mr. Ratan Debnath under the brand name Longtharai, with no record of acquisition.

Dhanhar Exim Private Limited.note: The company is an active independent business operated by its founding family directors, Hitesh and Jignesh Wankawala, with no history of acquisition.

Goldiee Masale Private Limited.note: The company continues to be an unfunded, family-owned business managed by its founding families, the Goenkas and Guptas.

Jay Bharat Spices Private Limited.note: The company remains independently owned and operated by its founding promoters, the Panda family, under the brand name 'Bharat Masala'.

L V Spices.note: L V Spices operates independently as the parent entity that owns and manufactures the 365 Spicery brand.

Maharaj Traders.note: The company is a standalone food processing business promoted by Mr. M. Baskar and continues its operations independently.

Minchys Food Products.note: Minchys Food Products remains an independent, family-owned company founded and managed by the Minocha family.

Nirmal Masala Udyog.note: There is no verifiable record of Nirmal Masala Udyog being acquired, and it remains an independently operating spice business.

Pravin Masalewale.note: Pravin Masalewale continues to operate independently as a prominent family-owned enterprise manufacturing spices under the Suhana brand.

Roopak Stores Pvt. Ltd..note: Roopak Stores Private Limited has operated independently as a premium spice retailer since its establishment in 1958.

Shree Masala Private Limited.note: The brand operates under Zeel Gruh Udhyog based in Gujarat and there is no record of an acquisition.

Spyran Retail Private Limited.note: Spyran Retail operates independently with an established retail network for its traditional masala and spice portfolio.

Symega Food Ingredients Limited.note: Symega Food Ingredients Limited continues to operate as a wholly owned subsidiary under its parent group, Synthite Industries.

Vasant Masala Pvt. Ltd..note: Vasant Masala Private Limited operates independently as an unfunded family-led spice manufacturing company.
